subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps / demo scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps / demo scheduling

Hi Tom  thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- We covered CloudBridge's marketplace flow, core integration touchpoints (auth, billing, deployment), and initial performance/scale requirements.
- You mentioned wanting a technical deep-dive with one of your GSI partners to align on deployment patterns and networking.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive (Redwood + CloudBridge + GSI engineer) to walk architecture and integration requirements.
2) Mateo (cc'd) will cover runtime/latency constraints and answer quantization/throughput questions.
3) Please share an agenda and preferred times; I listed a few slots below.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 4/10 10:00-11:00 or 15:00-16:00
- Wed 4/11 09:30-10:30 or 14:00-15:00

If those don't work, please shoot over a Calendly link or send an invite. Suggested agenda: 10m intros, 25m architecture/deep-dive, 20m integration Q&A, 5m next steps.

Attachments: agenda.pdf (draft).

Thanks  looking forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Tom  Wed 4/11 09:30-10:30 PDT works for us. Mateo, can you lead the technical portion and prepare answers on: expected token throughput, KV cache sizing, recommended quantization profiles, and network egress patterns?

Tom  I've attached a high-level architecture diagram (cloudbridge-arch-diagram.png) and a short list of integration questions below to share with Ravi:

Key integration questions for GSI:
- How will tenant onboarding work on the GSI side (SAML/OIDC or API-driven)?
- Expected peak concurrent requests and typical session lengths?
- Any egress/network constraints (VPC peering, private link)?
- Data retention/audit requirements for request logs and KV cache persistence?

If you want, we can open a shared doc for the agenda  otherwise I'll accept the calendar invite for Wed 4/11 09:30 PDT.

Best,
Marissa
